new_libraries.name: SyslogSender
new_libraries.author: Péter Soós <https://github.com/soosp>
new_libraries.sentence: Sends RFC 5424 syslog messages over UDP; forwards ESP_LOG on ESP32.
new_libraries.paragraph: A sender, not a logging framework: frames and sends what ESP_LOG (ESP32), a library's logger callback, or the application hands it. No queue, no heap after begin(), thread-safe on ESP32, host-testable framing. Depends on Host for target validation.
